review.description: Adopt verified subscription/filter/retry/expiry lifecycle as S1/S2 and retain the unavailable real-host delivery gate as S3.
review.implementation: Reviewed Subscribe challenge/identity/rotation persistence, Tick delivery/retry and Unsubscribe deletion, plus event discovery. Host receipt is kept distinct from callback HTTP acceptance.
review.tests: Read the event assertions rather than relying on the broad test name: signatures, duplicate identity, entity filter, retry IDs, expiry and idempotent unsubscribe are asserted. Changed-key refresh, restart and post-unsubscribe no-delivery need dedicated assertions; real-host S3 remains blocked.
